label.zh: 采纳控制论传统时按DLC与帝国类型三选一
label.en: One version on adopting the Cybernetics traditions, by DLC and empire type

note.zh: 有“机械时代”时普通帝国进入“义体化”局势、蜂巢进入蜂巢版局势；无该DLC（或“强制重置”起源）时为“血肉苦弱”项目。本地已安装机械时代。
note.en: With Machine Age: the Cyberization situation (hive version for hive minds); without it, or with the Hard Reset origin: the Flesh is Weak project. Machine Age is installed locally.

label.zh: 第四阶段只出现对手对应的一件
label.en: Stage 4 shows only the event of the current rival

note.zh: 第四阶段开始（进度750后）同时调用三者，但各自要求不同的对手标记（政府/企业/独立），只会显示一件；现已挂在第三阶段之后（machine_age_situation_events_1.txt:1490-1741）。
note.en: Stage 4 (after progress 750) calls all three, each requires a different rival flag, so only one shows; they now hang after stage 3 (machine_age_situation_events_1.txt:1490-1741).

label.zh: 按政体只出现其一
label.en: One by government authority

scope.zh: 整条故事：三选一入口、乌托邦版项目、两个局势的阶段与月度事件、第四阶段互斥对手事件、完成与未来震撼、月度随机事件池（以外链连到各自的故事）。
scope.en: Whole story: three-way entry, the Utopia project, both situations' stages and monthly events, the exclusive stage-4 rival events, completion and Future Shock, the monthly random pools (external links to their own stories).

uncertain: Situation progress speed depends on approach, traditions and situation flags; the gates above are progress values, not dates.
The random-pool events are separate one-doc stories owned by c7a; only linked externally.
